text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three years in the Twinkle Series that 
I somehow managed to run through together 
with Believe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having reached a turning point, as for 
her—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, time for the race right this 
instant!!!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No, I won't be doing that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I spent lively days together with my 
usual, unchanging companions."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Believe, moving fast is a good thing. 
It's very, very good, in fact. ...So 
please, hear me out instead of rejecting 
me at top speed."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I've been riding high lately. 
It's almost as if I've hit a second growth 
spurt.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, she seems to be in great shape.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that right! Exactly! At this rate, 
in my imagination, I'd even outrun a 
cheetah on one leg!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: That's very positive of you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Hold it right there, I challenge you!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Stealing a march won't be permitted, 
Daitaku Helios. Believe, who has now 
firmly cemented her throne as the sprint 
queen—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am the one destined to strike her down 
in a single blow and offer the throne to 
my liege. None other than Durandal could 
ever suffice!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
How could I just wait? Saying stuff like, 
"If you're gonna challenge someone, you 
need a cool challenge letter"—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Every single night in the dorm, how many 
times must you rewrite it to be satisfied? 
Lately you've lost your way completely. 
Even Believe would be at a loss if you 
handed her something in Latin.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Could you please not say everything out 
loud every single time?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Before that, first things first.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't accepted any challenge, you 
know. Not me."
choice_data_list: (These three really... get along so well.)
(These three really... get along so well.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their usual interactions were pure 
entertainment in themselves. Mainly 
because about two of them had quite loud 
voices, it often elicited chuckles from 
those around them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, there's no need to go 
out of your way to compete in a place like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
We'll see each other soon anyway— The 
three of us are going to race together, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And as expected, Calstone Light O takes 
the lead! The straight-line specialist 
Calstone Light O is tearing ahead! 
Incredible speed, what a blazing pace!!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Durandal is in this race too. If 
you follow without thinking, you'll be 
reeled in and passed at the very end."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
One would want to calmly conserve stamina 
here—however!! This is the Short-Distance 
Queen's domain!! Believe will not allow 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O bursts forward. Believe 
maintains the pace. Durandal watches for 
her chance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And in the end—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is it Calstone Light O?! Durandal?! Or 
Believe?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's just these three remaining!! Now, 
which Umamusume will seize the title of 
the fastest—?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...No one. No one can ever reach their 
domain. It's out of reach—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... Pheeew...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...At times like this, I find myself 
wishing things could last just a little 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...No, though I'd prefer a 1200m distance.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That is true. Though personally, I'd 
rather it be around 1,000 meters, but 
that's beside the point.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
As long as we keep running longer, and 
longer, and longer—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It feels as though there's no speed that's 
beyond reach.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"You say something really nice every once 
in a while, Light O."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I think so too.
